rights_review.inclusion_basis: Checklist §1 alternative: attributed extraction of lexical facts, not republication of the dictionary. Jambu source CSV contains Mahali headwords, printed IPA readings, short English labels, grammatical analysis, page/item citations and editorial notes. Individual words, pronunciations, short labels and observed grammatical categories are factual lexical data. Jambu applies its own transcription profile, schema and search organization. This is an editorial assessment of factual reuse, not a claim that the PDF is licensed, that permission was granted, or that all 2451 source entries are public domain.
rights_review.preexisting_project_precedent: CUJ Asur 2020 and Watters Kusunda 2006 source packages also include attributed lexical attestations from copyrighted publications while excluding source PDFs and literary/prose content.
rights_review.excluded_from_installed_rows: PDF pages, images, source-layout facsimiles, Bengali/Hindi translations, prose definitions, illustrations and publisher API prose; raw publisher responses and page renders remain outside the repository in local cache.
rights_review.scope_caveat: The complete set of 2451 printed records is a substantial extraction; rights basis should be revisited before public release if project policy or publisher terms require permission. No public release was performed in this source-stage task.
